o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *kaŕgan, compare Chuvash хуран (huran).
From the syncope of Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (uyuχu) (?); ultimately from Proto-Turkic *ūdï-.
From Proto-Common Turkic *biliš, from Proto-Turkic *bilił; equivalent to bil- (“to know”) + -iş. Cognate with Shor пилиш (piliš), Southern Altai билиш (biliš), Uzbek bilish, etc.
